input_domain: every string [+-]YYYY[Y]-01-01T00:00:00Z: four or five year digits with no sign, a plus sign or a minus sign
limitations: UA_DateTime_parse only; month, day, time and zone are fixed to -01-01T00:00:00Z and there is no fraction; parseInt64 and parseUInt64 (deps/parse_num.c), musl_tm_to_secs and its helpers (deps/libc_time.c), isTrue and UA_CHECK (src/util/ua_util_internal.h) and the type and constant definitions are not extracted by the gate but copied into the prelude from the same revision; three loops, two in parseUInt64 and the fraction loop of UA_DateTime_parse, with an unwinding bound of 6
